ops.body: - [ ] **Do:** on a phone, finish a walk with a photo, a video, a voice memo and a note kept apart and a photo and a note where it ends, watch its replay to the card, then open Chronicle's map. **Expect:** MapLibre RN and the native pin views draw Earth and ink (decision 0187): on beat one the lit streets read slate blue under the faint green trace, never the accent's orange; the end is a blue-violet bullseye (`#5b5d9f`); the photo pin is verdigris, the video madder, the memo raw umber, the note stone, each with its white glyph; the pin at the end has a charcoal head with its kinds' discs. (MP13)
